verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a data-pipeline platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk or batch capability, such as multi-select editing, bulk sync triggers, or batch API endpoints. The Airbyte API, Terraform provider and PyAirbyte are developer building blocks for scripting many operations, not a documented bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
